Subject to recall 25V-/23V345 covering MY2023-2025 PHEV for software-driven freeze/blank issue — fixed via free dealer software update; vehicles built after 2025-04-22 have corrected software from factory. Source: [Consumer Reports recall](https://www.consumerreports.org/cars/car-recalls-defects/mitsubishi-outlander-recalled-backup-camera-might-fail-a8010938419/).

subscriptionFeatures: MITSUBISHI CONNECT Remote Services (remote start, climate, lock/unlock, charging schedule, send-to-car navigation, dealer scheduler) and Safeguard (SOS, automatic collision notification, stolen vehicle assistance, mileage tracker) included 2 years; renewal pricing approximately $99/yr Remote, $69/yr Safeguard at recent prices. Vehicle drives, heats/cools, plays music, runs CarPlay/Android Auto, and charges via plug without an active subscription. Source: [MITSUBISHI CONNECT FAQ](https://www.mitsubishi-connect.com/en/SafeguardRemote/Manual/eclipse-cross_US/contents/tp_04_FAQ.html).
drmNotes: Core driving functions work offline. MITSUBISHI CONNECT telematics (Safeguard + Remote Services) provides remote start, lock/unlock, charging-schedule control via app — included 2 years, then subscription. Vehicle drives normally without active subscription. PHEV-specific app features (charging status, scheduled charging from app) require connectivity. From MY2025 includes Stolen Vehicle Assistance with Engine Blockage — remote ignition-block invoked by law enforcement after a verified police report. knownIssues: Rearview camera display freeze/blank (recall 25V- / 23V345, software fix applied at dealer). Some owner reports of charging-schedule app glitches via MITSUBISHI CONNECT. Source: [Cars.com Outlander PHEV recalls](https://www.cars.com/research/mitsubishi-outlander_phev/recalls/).
recalls: **25V-XXX / 23V345 (expanded 2025)**: Rearview camera software in A-IVI infotainment may freeze or blank when reversing — affects ~198,940 MY2023-2025 Outlander PHEV. Free dealer software update. Owner notifications mailed by 2025-06-30. Source: [Fox Business recall coverage](https://www.foxbusiness.com/lifestyle/another-automaker-recalls-nearly-200000-vehicles-due-rearview-camera-issue), [Consumer Reports](https://www.consumerreports.org/cars/car-recalls-defects/mitsubishi-outlander-recalled-backup-camera-might-fail-a8010938419/).
stateIncentives: Federal IRA §30D credit not available at point of sale — Outlander PHEV is assembled in Japan, fails final-assembly-in-North-America test. State incentives: CA CVRP closed to PHEVs; NJ, NY, CT, MA, IL, CO offer varying PHEV rebates or tax credits ($1,000-$4,000 typical). Mitsubishi offered up to $4,500 factory rebate on MY2025 SE/SEL/Premium/Black Edition/Platinum trims (manufacturer cash). 5-year TCO at 15,000 mi/yr. **No Mitsubishi Outlander PHEV-specific TCO breakdown is published by Edmunds, KBB, or CarEdge** (PHEV trim has no dedicated CarEdge `/outlander-phev/costs` page; SE-trim figures are not separately published). Sourced from gas-Outlander CarEdge baseline plus PHEV-specific adjustments for depreciation and fuel.

- Depreciation $22,500 — iSeeCars PHEV-specific 49.6% / $20,073 ([iseecars.com/car/mitsubishi-outlander-phev/resale-value](https://www.iseecars.com/car/mitsubishi-outlander-phev/resale-value)) adjusted upward to MSRP $43,245 + $1,745 dest ≈ $44,990 × 49.6% = $22,315 ≈ $22,500.
- Insurance $13,435 ($2,687/yr) — CarEdge Outlander ([caredge.com/mitsubishi/outlander/costs](https://caredge.com/mitsubishi/outlander/costs)).
- Maintenance $2,487 — CarEdge Outlander ($497/yr); 2 yr / 30k mi complimentary maintenance reduces early-year out-of-pocket.
- Repairs $1,200 — PHEV-adjusted upward from CarEdge baseline (battery & power-electronics service).
- Fuel/electricity $8,000 — PHEV-adjusted from CarEdge's gas-Outlander $8,555. Assumes ~60% of 15k mi/yr on battery (45mi EV range, 73 MPGe combined; 26 MPG gas mode).
- Financing $6,500 — CarEdge Outlander $6,042 adjusted for higher PHEV MSRP (72mo, 6.99% APR, 20% down).
- Taxes & fees $4,800 — typical 5-yr for ~$44k vehicle.
